newsitem.title: USA: Frontier taking Q4 $65 mln charge, EPS hurt.
newsitem.headline: Frontier taking Q4 $65 mln charge, EPS hurt.

text.p: Frontier Corp said Tuesday its fourth quarter and 1997 earnings per share will be cut by a $65 million charge it plans to take in the coming quarter.

The fourth quarter charge, equal to $0.24 per share, covers curtailment of certain company pension plans and the resolution of billing disputes with carriers handling traffic for Frontier's international calls, Frontier said.
Frontier said the billing dispute resolution is "the only one of these charges that is expected to have a continuing impact on the firm."
The continuing effect of these higher international costs will hurt earnings from operations in the range of $0.04 per share in the fourth quarter and have a similar impact in 1997, the company said.
"Absent other mitigating factors, this issue could result in earnings per share next year that are as much as 7 to 9 percent below current analysts' expectations," the company said in a release.
